A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a laser frequency comb has been used to calibrate a spectrograph with an absolute radial velocity repeatability of a few cm s−1.
we have developed an astronomical spectrograph that has a short-term Dopple shift repeatability that has not been achieved before.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a laser comb can be used as a spectrograph calibration source for astronomical observations, and that the stability of the calibration is limited by the spectrograph and not by the laser.
a laser frequency comb is a very stable and accurate calibration source for an astronomical spectrograph.
